notes: TBox expansion paired with history-replace-0007 (ancient Egyptian royal pyramid: a tomb -> a granary). Keeps the relation built_as and the new object a granary. The subject is a made-up class, the Hetepkara monuments, a newly identified kind of ancient Egyptian royal monument.
